description: Documented historical events and optional per-draw drawing-equipment metadata; unknown values are never inferred.

events.title: Lotto begins with six numbers from 1–40
events.note: The core six-from-40 format is the baseline; historical results may have a different draw schedule.

events.title: Wednesday Lotto draws added
events.note: More draws per year, not different six-from-40 selection odds. Date based on the October 2015 midweek introduction.

events.title: Powerball number pool expanded from 10 to 14
events.note: Legislation took effect 13 September 2026; first Wednesday draw under the new rules was 16 September 2026.

machine_rotation.note: Four active machines from a pool of six and four rotating ball sets. Actual machine/ball-set assignment for individual draws has not been obtained.

individual_machine_ids.note: Do not infer machine identity from weekday, draw number, date, presenter, or result.

individual_ball_set_ids.note: Do not infer ball set identity.

operator_ids.note: Only record operator identity with reliable draw-level records; no evidence of an effect on outcomes.
